about:
Waterbury Electronic Supply operates from Waterbury, Connecticut, at 47 Stevens Street. The company has been in business since 1995 and is led by Ron Hapken, Matt Hapken, and Pat Hapken. It began as a franchised distributor of quality electronic parts and components, aiming to bring value to every customer.

The firm distributes a broad line of electronic components including connectors, relays, switches, potentiometers, power supplies, enclosures, displays, and more. It also offers value‑added services such as sheet metal fabrication and off‑shore PCB supply chain services with quick turnaround and production. Custom enclosure design is available through the BOXCAD online tool, and the company holds ISO 9001:2015 certification.

Waterbury Electronic Supply serves customers in industries that require electronic components, such as industrial automation, telecommunications, medical devices, and general electronics manufacturing. Its franchised distributor status means it supplies parts from recognized manufacturers.

The company states its guiding principles: treating customers and suppliers as they would want to be treated, delivering customer value through quality parts, fair pricing, and excellent service, doing everything possible to help customers, and supporting customers' cost‑saving initiatives.
